product_name: Covo Cat Basket - Oak/Sand
description: The Covo is one of those pieces that reads as furniture first and cat bed second. Its rounded shell of bent plywood rises higher at the back, so your cat settles into a hollow that feels held on three sides while the open front keeps an easy view of the room. Uta Cossmann shaped it to sit comfortably in a living space rather than get tucked out of sight. Under the wood sits a thick foam cushion cut to the curve of the shell. It gives real support for older cats and lifts off in one motion when it needs a wash. The frame is built to last for years, and a quick wipe keeps the veneer looking new. A German design house MiaCara is a family run German label from Herzogenaurach, started by Sebastian and Barbara Zweig. It began with their Labrador, Cara, who turned her nose up at a cheap foam cushion, and grew into a full design house that launched its cat line in 2015. The credo is form follows function, innovate rather than imitate, so every piece is drawn to work first and then to sit quietly in a room. Design that earns its place The point of a MiaCara piece is that it does not read as pet gear. A feeder looks like a considered object on the floor, a bed reads as a piece of furniture, and the cat's needs are solved inside a form that a design-led home would keep anyway. Nothing is loud, nothing is disposable, and each object is meant to stay in the room for years rather than be hidden away. Made in Europe, made to last Most of the range is manufactured in Germany and the rest of Europe from hand-picked suppliers, under fair conditions and short transport routes. The materials are chosen to age well: solid and engineered woods, powder-coated and recycled aluminium, molded felt, and porcelain for the bowls. Pieces are built to be cleaned, refilled, and re-cushioned rather than replaced, and spare cushions and covers are kept in the range for exactly that reason. Recycled by default MiaCara leans on recycled materials wherever it can: felt spun from recycled PET bottles, recycled aluminium, recycled foam, and fabric made from upcycled ocean plastic through the Seaqual initiative. Packaging is FSC certified or recycled, and the workshop has run on certified green electricity since 2021. The designers, and the awards Every piece is credited to the studio or designer behind it, among them Hans Thyge and Co, Regina Mol, Studio Nooi, and the MiaCara design team. The work has been recognised with a German Design Award and a Red Dot, which is rare for cat furniture and tells you the bar it is held to.

product_name: The Overlook - Natural Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Yes
description: The Overlook takes everything cats love about the smaller Grotto and gives it more room to breathe. Across three distinct privacy levels it suits a multi-cat home, with several ways in and out of every resting area so no cat gets cornered. A ladder helps smaller cats reach the middle level, and the hammocks are spaced to leave gaps on either side for interactive play between cats at different heights. Bamboo panels carry the signature triangle cutouts for sightlines and hunting practice, and a Window Panel upgrade widens the view on the second level. Down low is a cozy, private space with peek-through windows. The middle adds a solid bamboo shelf topped with a removable plush faux fur pad and two walls for moderate cover. Up top, an extra-large heavyweight canvas hammock delivers the big panoramic seat, a 16 inch jump up with an easy drop back to the floor. It is made from solid sustainable bamboo, metal poles, heavyweight canvas, and premium plush faux fur, and the soft parts come off for washing and swap out when they wear.

product_name: Horizontal Scratching Post - English Chestnut Bamboo / 2-Tier / Double
description: Mount the pole horizontally and it changes the whole game. Now your cat gets a long sisal surface to stretch along and rake, and because it sits up the wall it nudges them to jump for it, which is exercise dressed up as play. Your furniture gets a break in the bargain. The poles fit on the front or the back of the mounting plank, which lets you build doubled-up posts and mix diagonal, vertical, and horizontal runs into one interlocking climb. That variety is a gift in a multi-cat home. Anchor one plank into a stud and use the drywall anchors for the second, though for the steadiest result and easy expansion later, aim to hit studs with both.

product_name: The Crossroads - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / 16"
description: The Crossroads is a scratcher's dream. The X-shaped centerpiece hands cats a big, inviting climbing frame where they can jump, scale, and rake their way to the top, and the poles branch into several routes so play stretches out for hours. When the energy runs down, there is a scratcher bed high on the wall for a private nap. Getting up starts at the angled scratcher, which works as both an inclined clawing surface and a ramp, an easy on-ramp for bigger cats or nervous climbers, and a gentle gatekeeper that keeps non-cat roommates out of the clubhouse. From there cats branch off, dropping onto a canvas hammock for the afternoon or pushing up the horizontal scratcher to keep exploring. A second nook up top adds a semi-enclosed cubby with a canvas side wall and a shelf overhead. It is made for both 16 and 24 inch stud spacing. It suits energetic cats and loungers alike, and it plays well with feather toys and ribbon, which is why you will spot it in cat cafes. Big cats and kittens both take to it.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture > Cat Trees & Towers

product_name: The Grotto - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas
description: The Grotto proves small does not mean simple. In a tidy footprint it packs a range of spaces, each with a different degree of seclusion, so a bold cat and a shy one can share it and both feel at home. product_name: Enclosed Cat Bed - English Chestnut Bamboo / Slotted
description: Some cats love a lookout. Others just want a wall between themselves and the room. This cubby is for the second kind, enclosed on most sides to make a snug, low-key retreat where a shy or private cat can settle and feel unbothered. It sits up off the floor, out of the traffic, close enough to keep tabs but far enough to relax. How closed it feels is up to you. Blank or brick fronts give the most cover, the porthole and baby dragon cutouts add a peekhole and a little whimsy, and the slotted panel keeps things airy while still feeling tucked in. It is sized for 16 inch studs and goes up cleanly.

product_name: The Juggernaut - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Planter Shelves / Leaf Shelf
description: The Juggernaut is the flagship, and it shows. It stacks in multiple hammocks, a sisal scratching pole, floating scratching posts, a bridge across the middle, and a planter shelf for a bit of green. There is enough room and enough different routes that a crowd of cats, or a couple of very large ones, can spread out and never feel boxed in. Movement is the whole point. Cats perch, prowl, and pick their way through the features, and for a gentler climb the escape hatch and roped bridge offer an easier line up. Leaf shelves on the pole add even more branches if you have several cats or a territorial streak to manage. It is built for 16 inch spacing and can be special-ordered for 24 inch, so reach out if your studs differ. The planter shelf ships ready for cat-safe greenery like spider plant, lemon button fern, catnip, cat grass, variegated wax plant, lilyturf, or Boston fern. Plants are not included.

It stacks in multiple hammocks, a sisal scratching pole, floating scratching posts, a bridge across the middle, and a planter shelf for a bit of green. There is enough room and enough different routes that a crowd of cats, or a couple of very large ones, can spread out and never feel boxed in. Movement is the whole point. Cats perch, prowl, and pick their way through the features, and for a gentler climb the escape hatch and roped bridge offer an easier line up. Leaf shelves on the pole add even more branches if you have several cats or a territorial streak to manage. It is built for 16 inch spacing and can be special-ordered for 24 inch, so reach out if your studs differ. The planter shelf ships ready for cat-safe greenery like spider plant, lemon button fern, catnip, cat grass, variegated wax plant, lilyturf, or Boston fern. Plants are not included.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture > Cat Trees & Towers

product_name: The Roman Cat Condo - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Leaf Shelf
description: The Roman leans regal. It sets your cat between two Doric pillars to survey their realm, with two scratching poles, an escape hatch pathway, and a handful of hammocks for lounging in between conquests. There is plenty of surface for the claws and plenty of thrones for the naps. The multiple pathways matter beyond the theme, they let cats roam without feeling trapped, which lifts their comfort and sense of security in the condo. It suits a multi-cat home and is built for 16 inch stud spacing, so it goes up cleanly.

product_name: The Play - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas
description: If you are just getting into cat walls, the Play is a gentle way in. There is a ladder to chase toys up, an escape hatch to duck through, and fabric hammocks to flop into afterward, enough to keep a cat entertained without overwhelming a first-time setup. Our cat Heisenberg treats it as a fetch course, tearing up the ladder and settling in once the game winds down. It is built for homes with more than one cat and comes in versions for 16 and 24 inch stud spacing, so it slots onto most walls without a fuss.

product_name: The Expedition - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Planter
description: Think of the Expedition as the Juggernaut's trimmer sibling. It keeps the emphasis on activity, with plenty of restful spots worked in, and a 50 inch bridge ties the scratching pole to the rest of the structure. That bridge quickly becomes the hangout, the spot everyone claims. A leaf shelf sits partway up the scratching pole, and it does more than add a perch, it means your cat can move through the whole condo without hitting a dead end. Open routing like that keeps cats from feeling cornered and keeps the peace when there is more than one of them. It comes in versions for 16 and 24 inch stud spacing.

product_name: The Gardens - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Garden / Leaf Shelf
description: The Gardens is the big one, built for a full household of cats. It carries a generous run of hammocks so each cat can find its own spot without stepping on anyone, which keeps the territorial grumbling to a minimum. Four planters thread greenery through the whole thing, steering the chewing toward safe plants and giving curious cats something living to investigate. A central scratching pole handles the claws and doubles as the express route to the top level. If your wall cannot take the full spread, there is a Mini Garden layout that keeps the pole, hammocks, and escape hatch but trims down to two planters. Both are made for 16 or 24 inch stud spacing.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture > Cat Condos & Houses

product_name: Floating Cat Step
description: This is a scratcher and a foothold in one. Wrapped in tough natural sisal, it stands up to real clawing without the shedding and crumbling you get from cardboard, and mounted in a line these steps become a climbing route up the wall. The sisal is glued down the full length of the post, so it will not sag or unravel after a season of heavy use. It was made with renters in mind. The step goes into studs but will also take drywall, brick, or concrete, and it hangs on two standard number 8 screws, the same size you would use for a picture. A foam backing protects your paint, and pulling it off later leaves only two small holes to patch. As the original floating sisal post, it has had over a decade of refinement behind it, with a steel bracket rated to hold up to 70 pounds per post.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture > Cat Scratchers & Scratching Posts

product_name: Catnip Buds
description: These are the buds, not the dusty leaf and stem you usually get. Grown and picked by hand in Washington and cut late when the essential oils peak, they land far more potent than the bagged stuff. Break a bud off the stem, crush it between your fingers to wake up the aroma, and hand it over. It is a treat with no downside, a hit of stimulation and zero calories, ideal right before a toy session to get a lazy cat off the couch. The buds are non-GMO and organically grown, and each order comes with a half ounce.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Treats

product_name: The Plateau - English Chestnut Bamboo/Charcoal Gray Canvas
description: The Plateau covers all the scratching bases. It carries two different scratching pole setups so whichever way your cat likes to work, up and down or side to side, the angled or horizontal pole has it handled. That means a stretch and a satisfying dig no matter the mood. For the downtime, a 34 inch shelf holds a cozy nest, a plush faux fur spot to curl into after the workout. Several vertical levels and a good amount of climbing space keep the whole thing active. It spans seven studs on 16 inch centers, so there is real room to roam.

Once it is up, it links straight into hammocks and shelves as your setup grows.

product_name: Catnip Spray for Cats
description: Made from the essential oils pressed out of catnip buds, this spray delivers the good part without the mess. Because it is concentrated oil rather than dried extract, it tends to land harder than sprinkling loose catnip, and it soaks in where you want it. A quick mist revives a toy that has lost its charm or helps a wary cat warm up to a new canvas hammock. It earns its keep as a training aid too. Spritz a sisal pole or scratcher, wave a toy over it, and you have a simple way to steer claws off the couch and onto the right surface. The formula is nothing but pure catnip essential oil and distilled water, and a one ounce bottle gives you up to 200 sprays.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Treats

product_name: The Catacombs - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / 16"
description: The Catacombs is built around movement. Leaf shelves branch off the scratching pole to open up route after route through the condo, which is exactly what a multi-cat home needs, more ways through means fewer dead ends and fewer chances for one cat to trap another. Less cornering, less conflict. Four separate hammocks give each cat somewhere to settle while the others keep circulating. And the leaf shelves are not fixed, you can flip them to change their look and spin them around the pole to widen the condo or carve out fresh paths to explore.

product_name: The Raceway - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas
description: The Raceway plays two ways. It links a pair of roomy 34 inch hammocks with a diagonal fabric run and a ladder for grip, so an energetic cat can sprint the track from one end to the other, then a tired one can melt into either hammock. It works solo or bolts onto another condo to widen the play area. We hung ours about fourteen inches above the sofa, using the lower hammock as the starting line and letting the cats climb to the upper level for the best nap in the house. It also makes a tidy on-ramp up the wall to connect with other pieces. Best for a home of one or two cats, built for 16 inch stud spacing.

description: The Double Decker stacks two beds into one piece. product_name: Coco Cat Basket - Beige
description: Coco starts with cotton rope, hand-woven into a rounded basket with the kind of even, tactile finish that only comes from patient work. product_name: Weenect XS Cat GPS Tracker - Tracker only / Black
description: A cat who slips outside can be halfway down the block before you notice. The Weenect XS puts their live location on your phone, refreshed as often as every second, so you can see where they actually go and call them home with a sound and a light when it is time to come in. It is the smallest real GPS tracker made for cats, light enough at 27 grams that most settle into it within a day. There is no range limit. A built-in SIM keeps it connected across the country and in more than 170 others, and you can draw safe zones on the map that ping you the moment your cat leaves one. The case is waterproof, the collar releases if it ever snags, and a full charge lasts up to a week in power-saving mode. Because the tracker sends its position over the mobile network, it runs on a subscription, the same way a phone does. Pick the tracker on its own and set up a plan once it arrives, or take the version with a full year included so it is ready the day you open the box. Either way you get the tracker, the elastic cat collar, a silicone case that clips to any collar or harness, and the charging cable. See it in action How it works The tracker clips into a silicone case on the collar and picks up satellites the moment your cat is outside. It sends the position over a built-in SIM to the Weenect app, where you see live location on a map, draw safe zones, and set off a sound or light to call your cat back. Why not just an AirTag? An AirTag only reports where it was last seen by a nearby Apple phone, which is little help if your cat is under a hedge two streets over. The Weenect XS uses real GPS, so it shows where your cat is right now, with no reliance on other people's phones and no distance limit. Backed for life Weenect gives the XS a lifetime guarantee against manufacturing defects and normal wear, so the hardware is covered for as long as you use it.

description: A lot of cats want privacy at the box, and a lot of owners want the mess and the smell kept out of sight. Made to last, made responsibly Where it can, Hoopo builds from recycled or plant based materials: recycled ABS on the hooded boxes, stainless steel on the open ones, pine and thick sisal on the scratchers, and a plant based tofu litter that composts. product_name: Neo Plus Cat Self Groomer
description: Most cats groom themselves anyway, so this box just gives them a better spot to do it. As a cat walks through, a ring of six flexible brushes turns with its movement and lifts the loose fur off its coat from every side, dropping it into a sealed chamber. That means less shedding on the couch and fewer hairballs to deal with later. See it in action How it works Put a few treats inside and let your cat do the rest. As it walks through the tunnel, its own movement turns the ring of brushes, which press in gently from every side. The soft, barbed felt lifts the loose undercoat and carries it into a chamber, so the fur ends up collected instead of on your couch. The wheel only turns when the cat moves and stops the instant it stops, so there is nothing to pinch or startle. Gentle on every cat The brushes are spring loaded and self adjusting, so a slim cat and a big Maine Coon both get even, comfortable pressure. It is sized for large breeds and multi cat homes, and works for cats up to about thirty five pounds. Settling a shy cat The entrance opening is adjustable. Start it wide so a nervous cat can wander through without feeling boxed in, then narrow it over a week or so once the habit sticks, which is when the grooming works best. Cleaning it out When the chamber fills, open it, tip out the fur, and wipe the parts down. Everything washes with a mild detergent, and the aerospace grade felt keeps its shape for years.
